entities.description: This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface-such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava-as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat).
entities.text:
This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface-such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava-as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat). Up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range gain this ability for the duration.
  An affected target must take a Bonus Action to pass from the liquid's surface into the liquid itself and vice versa, but if the target falls into the liquid, the target passes through the surface into the liquid below.
entities.brief: Up to 10 creatures walk on water and other liquids. Ritual.

entities.name: Web
entities.description: You conjure a mass of sticky webbing at a point within range. The webs fill a 20-foot Cube there for the duration. The webs are Difficult Terrain, and the area within them is Lightly Obscured.
entities.text:
You conjure a mass of sticky webbing at a point within range. The webs fill a 20-foot Cube there for the duration. The webs are Difficult Terrain, and the area within them is Lightly Obscured.
  If the webs aren't anchored between two solid masses (such as walls or trees) or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling, the web collapses on itself, and the spell ends at the start of your next turn. Webs layered over a flat surface have a depth of 5 feet.
  The first time a creature enters the webs on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Restrained condition while in the webs or until it breaks free.
  A creature Restrained by the webs can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer Restrained.
  The webs are flammable. Any 5-foot Cube of webs exposed to fire burns away in 1 round, dealing 2d4 Fire damage to any creature that starts its turn in the fire.
entities.brief: 20-ft cube of webs: Difficult Terrain; creatures save or are Restrained. Webs burn.

entities.name: Weird
entities.description: You try to create illusory terrors in others' minds. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range makes a Wisdom saving throw.
entities.text:
You try to create illusory terrors in others' minds. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 10d10 Psychic damage and has the Frightened condition for the duration. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.
   A Frightened target makes a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a failed save, it takes 5d10 Psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends on that target.
entities.brief: You try to create illusory terrors in others' minds. Each creature in a 30 ft-radius Sphere centered on a point makes a Wis save.

entities.name: Wind Walk
entities.description: You and up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range assume gaseous forms for the duration, appearing as wisps of cloud.
entities.text:
You and up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range assume gaseous forms for the duration, appearing as wisps of cloud. While in this cloud form, a target has a Fly Speed of 300 feet and can hover; it has Immunity to the Prone condition; and it has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. The only actions a target can take in this form are the Dash action or a Magic action to begin reverting to its normal form. Reverting takes 1 minute, during which the target has the Stunned condition. Until the spell ends, the target can revert to cloud form, which also requires a Magic action followed by a 1-minute transformation.
  If a target is in cloud form and flying when the effect ends, the target descends 60 feet per round for 1 minute until it lands, which it does safely. If it can't land after 1 minute, it falls the remaining distance.
entities.brief: You and up to ten willing creatures assume gaseous forms, appearing as wisps of cloud.

entities.name: Wind Wall
entities.description: A wall of strong wind rises from the ground at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick.
entities.text:
A wall of strong wind rises from the ground at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick. You can shape the wall in any way you choose so long as it makes one continuous path along the ground. The wall lasts for the duration.
  When the wall appears, each creature in its area makes a Strength saving throw, taking 4d8 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
  The strong wind keeps fog, smoke, and other gases at bay. Small or smaller flying creatures or objects can't pass through the wall. Loose, lightweight materials brought into the wall fly upward. Arrows, bolts, and other ordinary projectiles launched at targets behind the wall are deflected upward and miss automatically. Boulders hurled by Giants or siege engines, and similar projectiles, are unaffected. Creatures in gaseous form can't pass through it.
entities.brief: Wall of wind 50 ft long: Bludgeoning on appearance; blocks arrows, gas and small fliers.

entities.name: Wish
entities.description: Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter reality itself. The basic use of this spell is to duplicate any other spell of level 8 or lower.
entities.text:
Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter reality itself.
  The basic use of this spell is to duplicate any other spell of level 8 or lower. If you use it this way, you don't need to meet any requirements to cast that spell, including costly components. The spell simply takes effect.
  Alternatively, you can create one of the following effects of your choice: Object Creation. You create one object of up to 25,000 GP in value that isn't a magic item. The object can be no more than 300 feet in any dimension, and it appears in an unoccupied space that you can see on the ground. Instant Health. You allow yourself and up to twenty creatures that you can see to regain all Hit Points, and you end all effects on them listed in the Greater Restoration spell. Resistance. You grant up to ten creatures that you can see Resistance to one damage type that you choose. This Resistance is permanent. Spell Immunity. You grant up to ten creatures you can see immunity to a single spell or other magical effect for 8 hours. Sudden Learning. You replace one of your feats with another feat for which you are eligible. You lose all the benefits of the old feat and gain the benefits of the new one. You can't replace a feat that is a prerequisite for any of your other feats or features. Roll Redo. You undo a single recent event by forcing a reroll of any die roll made within the last round (including your last turn). Reality reshapes itself to accommodate the new result. For example, a Wish spell could undo an ally's failed saving throw or a foe's Critical Hit. You can force the reroll to be made with Advantage or Disadvantage, and you choose whether to use the reroll or the original roll. Reshape Reality. You may wish for something not included in any of the other effects. To do so, state your wish to the GM as precisely as possible. The GM has great latitude in ruling what occurs in such an instance; the greater the wish, the greater the likelihood that something goes wrong. This spell might simply fail, the effect you desire might be achieved only in part, or you might suffer an unforeseen consequence as a result of how you worded the wish. For example, wishing that a villain were dead might propel you forward in time to a period when that villain is no longer alive, effectively removing you from the game. Similarly, wishing for a Legendary magic item or an Artifact might instantly transport you to the presence of the item's current owner. If your wish is granted and its effects have consequences for a whole community, region, or world, you are likely to attract powerful foes. If your wish would affect a god, the god's divine servants might instantly intervene to prevent it or to encourage you to craft the wish in a particular way. If your wish would undo the multiverse itself, your wish fails. The stress of casting Wish to produce any effect other than duplicating another spell weakens you. After enduring that stress, each time you cast a spell until you finish a Long Rest, you take 1d10 Necrotic damage per level of that spell. This damage can't be reduced or prevented in any way. In addition, your Strength score becomes 3 for 2d4 days. For each of those days that you spend resting and doing nothing more than light activity, your remaining recovery time decreases by 2 days. Finally, there is a 33 percent chance that you are unable to cast Wish ever again if you suffer this stress.
entities.brief: Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter reality itself.

entities.name: Word of Recall
entities.description: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary.
entities.text:
You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary. You and any creatures that teleport with you appear in the nearest unoccupied space to the spot you designated when you prepared your sanctuary (see below). If you cast this spell without first preparing a sanctuary, the spell has no effect.
  You must designate a location, such as a temple, as a sanctuary by casting this spell there.
entities.brief: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 ft of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary.

entities.name: Zone of Truth
entities.description: You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range.
entities.text:
You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, a creature that enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can't speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this save.
  An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.
entities.brief: 15-ft-radius sphere: creatures that fail a Cha save can't lie deliberately.

entities.name: Blinded
entities.description: While you have the Blinded condition, you experience the following effects. Can't See. You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight. Attacks Affected.
entities.text:
While you have the Blinded condition, you experience the following effects.
**Can't See.** You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight.
**Attacks Affected.** Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

entities.name: Charmed
entities.description: While you have the Charmed condition, you experience the following effects. Can't Harm the Charmer. You can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with damaging abilities or magical effects. Social Advantage.
entities.text:
While you have the Charmed condition, you experience the following effects.
**Can't Harm the Charmer.** You can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with damaging abilities or magical effects.
**Social Advantage.** The charmer has Advantage on ability checks to interact socially with you.

entities.name: Deafened
entities.description: While you have the Deafened condition, you experience the following effect. Can't Hear. You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.
entities.text:
While you have the Deafened condition, you experience the following effect.
**Can't Hear.** You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.

entities.name: Exhaustion
entities.description: While you have the Exhaustion condition, you experience the following effects. Exhaustion Levels. This condition is cumulative. Each time you receive it, you gain 1 Exhaustion level.
entities.text:
While you have the Exhaustion condition, you experience the following effects.
**Exhaustion Levels.** This condition is cumulative. Each time you receive it, you gain 1 Exhaustion level. You die if your Exhaustion level is 6.
**D20 Tests Affected.** When you make a D20 Test, the roll is reduced by 2 times your Exhaustion level.
**Speed Reduced.** Your Speed is reduced by a number of feet equal to 5 times your Exhaustion level.
**Removing Exhaustion Levels.** Finishing a Long Rest removes 1 of your Exhaustion levels. When your Exhaustion level reaches 0, the condition ends.

entities.name: Frightened
entities.description: While you have the Frightened condition, you experience the following effects. Ability Checks and Attacks Affected.
entities.text:
While you have the Frightened condition, you experience the following effects.
**Ability Checks and Attacks Affected.** You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight.
**Can't Approach.** You can't willingly move closer to the source of your fear.

entities.name: Grappled
entities.description: While you have the Grappled condition, you experience the following effects. Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Attacks Affected.
entities.text:
While you have the Grappled condition, you experience the following effects.
**Speed 0.** Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
**Attacks Affected.** You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler.
**Movable.** The grappler can drag or carry you when it moves, but every foot of movement costs it 1 extra foot unless you are Tiny or two or more sizes smaller.

entities.name: Incapacitated
entities.description: While you have the Incapacitated condition, you experience the following effects. Inactive. You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction. No Concentration. Your Concentration is broken. Speechless.
entities.text:
While you have the Incapacitated condition, you experience the following effects.
**Inactive.** You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.
**No Concentration.** Your Concentration is broken.
**Speechless.** You can't speak.
**Surprised.** If you're Incapacitated when you roll Initiative, you have Disadvantage on the roll.

entities.name: Invisible
entities.description: While you have the Invisible condition, you experience the following effects. Surprise. If you're Invisible when you roll Initiative, you have Advantage on the roll. Concealed.
entities.text:
While you have the Invisible condition, you experience the following effects.
**Surprise.** If you're Invisible when you roll Initiative, you have Advantage on the roll.
**Concealed.** You aren't affected by any effect that requires its target to be seen unless the effect's creator can somehow see you. Any equipment you are wearing or carrying is also concealed.
**Attacks Affected.** Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage. If a creature can somehow see you, you don't gain this benefit against that creature.

entities.name: Paralyzed
entities.description: While you have the Paralyzed condition, you experience the following effects. Incapacitated. You have the Incapacitated condition. Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Saving Throws Affected.
entities.text:
While you have the Paralyzed condition, you experience the following effects.
**Incapacitated.** You have the Incapacitated condition.
**Speed 0.** Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
**Saving Throws Affected.** You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
**Attacks Affected.** Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
**Automatic Critical Hits.** Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

entities.name: Petrified
entities.description: While you have the Petrified condition, you experience the following effects. Turned to Inanimate Substance.
entities.text:
While you have the Petrified condition, you experience the following effects.
**Turned to Inanimate Substance.** You are transformed, along with any nonmagical objects you are wearing and carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone). Your weight increases by a factor of ten, and you cease aging.
**Incapacitated.** You have the Incapacitated condition.
**Speed 0.** Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
**Attacks Affected.** Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
**Saving Throws Affected.** You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
**Resist Damage.** You have Resistance to all damage.
**Poison Immunity.** You have Immunity to the Poisoned condition.
**Saving Throws Affected.** You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
**Resist Damage.** You have Resistance to all damage.
**Poison Immunity.** You have Immunity to the Poisoned condition.

entities.name: Poisoned
entities.description: While you have the Poisoned condition, you experience the following effect. Ability Checks and Attacks Affected. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
entities.text:
While you have the Poisoned condition, you experience the following effect.
**Ability Checks and Attacks Affected.** You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

entities.name: Prone
entities.description: While you have the Prone condition, you experience the following effects. Restricted Movement.
entities.text:
While you have the Prone condition, you experience the following effects.
**Restricted Movement.** Your only movement options are to crawl or to spend an amount of movement equal to half your Speed (round down) to right yourself and thereby end the condition. If your Speed is 0, you can't right yourself.
**Attacks Affected.** You have Disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Otherwise, that attack roll has Disadvantage.

entities.name: Restrained
entities.description: While you have the Restrained condition, you experience the following effects. Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Attacks Affected.
entities.text:
While you have the Restrained condition, you experience the following effects.
**Speed 0.** Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
**Attacks Affected.** Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.
**Saving Throws Affected.** You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

entities.name: Stunned
entities.description: While you have the Stunned condition, you experience the following effects. Incapacitated. You have the Incapacitated condition. Saving Throws Affected. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
entities.text:
While you have the Stunned condition, you experience the following effects.
**Incapacitated.** You have the Incapacitated condition.
**Saving Throws Affected.** You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
**Attacks Affected.** Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

entities.name: Unconscious
entities.description: While you have the Unconscious condition, you experience the following effects. Inert. You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions, and you drop whatever you're holding. When this condition ends, you remain Prone.
entities.text:
While you have the Unconscious condition, you experience the following effects.
**Inert.** You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions, and you drop whatever you're holding.
**When this condition ends, you remain Prone.
**Speed 0.** Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
**Attacks Affected.** Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
**Saving Throws Affected.** You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
**Automatic Critical Hits.** Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.
**Unaware.** You're unaware of your surroundings.

entities.name: Cleave
entities.description: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach.
entities.text: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

entities.name: Graze
entities.description: If your attack roll with this weapon misses a creature, you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll.
entities.text: If your attack roll with this weapon misses a creature, you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier.

entities.name: Nick
entities.description: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.
entities.text: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

entities.name: Push
entities.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.
entities.text: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

entities.name: Sap
entities.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.
entities.text: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

entities.name: Slow
entities.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
entities.text: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

entities.name: Topple
entities.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus).
entities.text: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Vex
entities.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.
entities.text: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

entities.name: Ritual
entities.description: A spell with the Ritual tag can be cast as a ritual: it takes 10 minutes longer than normal and uses no spell slot. You must have the spell prepared (a Wizard can cast rituals straight from the spellbook). It can’t be cast at a higher level this way.

entities.name: Concentration
entities.description: Some spells last only while you concentrate. It ends if you cast another Concentration spell, have the Incapacitated condition or die. When you take damage, make a Constitution save, DC 10 or half the damage (round down), whichever is higher, max DC 30 — on a failure the spell ends.

entities.name: Cantrip
entities.description: A level 0 spell: cast at will, without a spell slot. Damage cantrips get stronger at character levels 5, 11 and 17.

entities.name: Spell Slots
entities.description: Casting a spell of level 1 or higher expends a slot of that level or higher. A higher slot casts the spell at that level, often with a bigger effect (“Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot”). Slots come back on a Long Rest (Warlock Pact slots also on a Short Rest).

entities.name: Spell Attack
entities.description: An attack roll made with a spell: d20 + your spellcasting ability modifier + Proficiency Bonus. A ranged spell attack has Disadvantage while an enemy is within 5 feet of you.

entities.name: Saving Throw
entities.description: A d20 roll to resist a spell, trap or other effect: d20 + the ability modifier (+ Proficiency Bonus if proficient) against a DC. Spell save DC = 8 + spellcasting ability modifier + Proficiency Bonus.

entities.name: Action
entities.description: On your turn you can take one action: Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Influence, Magic, Ready, Search, Study or Utilize.

entities.name: Bonus Action
entities.description: An extra action you get only from a feature or spell that says so (Healing Word, Second Wind, off-hand attack…). One per turn, and you choose when to take it during your turn.

entities.name: Reaction
entities.description: An instant response to a trigger, on your turn or someone else’s — an Opportunity Attack, Shield, Counterspell. One per round: you get it back at the start of your turn.

entities.name: Magic Action
entities.description: The action used to cast a spell with a casting time of an action, use a magic item or a magical feature.

entities.name: Attack Action
entities.description: One attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike (more with Extra Attack). You can move between the attacks.

entities.name: Opportunity Attack
entities.description: When a creature you can see leaves your reach, you can use your Reaction to make one melee attack against it. Disengage and teleporting avoid it.

entities.name: Advantage
entities.description: Roll two d20s and use the higher. Advantage and Disadvantage cancel out, however many of each you have.

entities.name: Disadvantage
entities.description: Roll two d20s and use the lower. Advantage and Disadvantage cancel out, however many of each you have.

entities.name: Critical Hit
entities.description: A 20 on the d20 of an attack roll hits regardless of AC, and the attack’s damage dice are rolled twice (modifiers once).

entities.name: Armor Class
entities.description: How hard you are to hit: an attack roll hits if it equals or beats your AC. Unarmored: 10 + Dex modifier; armor, a Shield and features change it.

entities.name: Initiative
entities.description: At the start of combat everyone rolls a Dexterity check (d20 + Dex modifier + bonuses); turns go from highest to lowest.

entities.name: Speed
entities.description: How far you can move on your turn, in feet. Difficult Terrain costs 1 extra foot per foot; the Dash action adds your Speed again.

entities.name: Hit Points
entities.description: Damage lowers your HP; at 0 HP you fall Unconscious and make Death Saving Throws (damage of your HP maximum or more left over kills outright). Healing can’t exceed the maximum.

entities.name: Temporary Hit Points
entities.description: A buffer lost before your real HP. They don’t stack — take the higher amount — and healing doesn’t restore them. They last until used up or you finish a Long Rest.

entities.name: Death Saving Throw
entities.description: At 0 HP, roll a d20 at the start of each turn: 10+ is a success, lower a failure. 3 successes: Stable; 3 failures: dead. A 20 brings you back with 1 HP, a 1 counts as two failures; damage at 0 HP is a failure (a Critical Hit two).

entities.name: Hit Point Dice
entities.description: One die per level, by class. On a Short Rest, spend any number: roll each + Con modifier and regain that many HP. A Long Rest restores all of them.

entities.name: Short Rest
entities.description: At least 1 hour of light activity. You can spend Hit Point Dice to heal, and some features and Warlock Pact slots come back.

entities.name: Long Rest
entities.description: At least 8 hours (sleep + light activity), once per 24 hours. You regain all HP and all Hit Point Dice, spell slots and features come back, and Exhaustion drops by 1.

entities.name: Proficiency Bonus
entities.description: Added to attack rolls, checks and saves you are proficient in, and to your spell save DC: +2 at levels 1–4, +3 at 5–8, +4 at 9–12, +5 at 13–16, +6 at 17–20.

entities.name: Passive Perception
entities.description: 10 + your Wisdom (Perception) modifier (+5 with Advantage, −5 with Disadvantage). The GM uses it to see whether you notice something without looking.

entities.name: Difficult Terrain
entities.description: Every foot of movement in it costs 1 extra foot.

entities.name: Attunement
entities.description: Some magic items work only after you spend a Short Rest focused on them. You can be attuned to at most 3 items at once.

entities.name: Heroic Inspiration
entities.description: If you have it, you can expend it to reroll any one die and use the new roll. You can have only one at a time.

entities.name: Ammunition
entities.description: You can use a weapon that has the Ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from it. The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon's range.
entities.text: You can use a weapon that has the Ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from it. The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon's range. Each attack expends one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, you can spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition (round down) you used in the fight; the rest is lost.

entities.name: Finesse
entities.description: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.
entities.text: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

entities.name: Heavy
entities.description: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.
entities.text: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

entities.name: Light
entities.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn.
entities.text: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

entities.name: Loading
entities.description: You can fire only one piece of ammunition from a Loading weapon when you use an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.
entities.text: You can fire only one piece of ammunition from a Loading weapon when you use an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

entities.name: Range
entities.description: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range.
entities.text: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

entities.name: Reach
entities.description: A Reach weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for Opportunity Attacks with it.
entities.text: A Reach weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for Opportunity Attacks with it.

entities.name: Thrown
entities.description: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack.
entities.text: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

entities.name: Two-Handed
entities.description: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.
entities.text: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

entities.name: Versatile
entities.description: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.
entities.text: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entities.name: Acrobatics
entities.description: Stay on your feet in a tricky situation, or perform an acrobatic stunt.
entities.text: Stay on your feet in a tricky situation, or perform an acrobatic stunt.

entities.name: Animal Handling
entities.description: Calm or train an animal, or get an animal to behave in a certain way.
entities.text: Calm or train an animal, or get an animal to behave in a certain way.

entities.name: Arcana
entities.description: Recall lore about spells, magic items, and the planes of existence.
entities.text: Recall lore about spells, magic items, and the planes of existence.

entities.name: Athletics
entities.description: Jump farther than normal, stay afloat in rough water, or break something.
entities.text: Jump farther than normal, stay afloat in rough water, or break something.

entities.name: Deception
entities.description: Tell a convincing lie, or wear a disguise convincingly.
entities.text: Tell a convincing lie, or wear a disguise convincingly.

entities.name: History
entities.description: Recall lore about historical events, people, nations, and cultures.
entities.text: Recall lore about historical events, people, nations, and cultures.

entities.name: Insight
entities.description: Discern a person’s mood and intentions.
entities.text: Discern a person’s mood and intentions.

entities.name: Intimidation
entities.description: Awe or threaten someone into doing what you want.
entities.text: Awe or threaten someone into doing what you want.

entities.name: Investigation
entities.description: Find obscure information in books, or deduce how something works.
entities.text: Find obscure information in books, or deduce how something works.

entities.name: Medicine
entities.description: Diagnose an illness, or determine what killed the recently slain.
entities.text: Diagnose an illness, or determine what killed the recently slain.

entities.name: Nature
entities.description: Recall lore about terrain, plants, animals, and weather.
entities.text: Recall lore about terrain, plants, animals, and weather.

entities.name: Perception
entities.description: Using a combination of senses, notice something that’s easy to miss.
entities.text: Using a combination of senses, notice something that’s easy to miss.

entities.name: Performance
entities.description: Act, tell a story, perform music, or dance.
entities.text: Act, tell a story, perform music, or dance.

entities.name: Persuasion
entities.description: Honestly and graciously convince someone of something.
entities.text: Honestly and graciously convince someone of something.

entities.name: Religion
entities.description: Recall lore about gods, religious rituals, and holy symbols.
entities.text: Recall lore about gods, religious rituals, and holy symbols.

entities.name: Sleight of Hand
entities.description: Pick a pocket, conceal a handheld object, or perform legerdemain.
entities.text: Pick a pocket, conceal a handheld object, or perform legerdemain.

entities.name: Stealth
entities.description: Escape notice by moving quietly and hiding behind things.
entities.text: Escape notice by moving quietly and hiding behind things.

entities.name: Survival
entities.description: Follow tracks, forage, find a trail, or avoid natural hazards.
entities.text: Follow tracks, forage, find a trail, or avoid natural hazards.

entities.name: Unarmed Strike options
entities.description: Grapple and Shove replace one attack of the Attack action.

activities.name: Grapple
activities.summary: Target makes a Str or Dex save (its choice) or is Grappled. Needs a free hand; target at most one size larger.

activities.name: Shove
activities.summary: Target makes a Str or Dex save (its choice) or is pushed 5 ft away or knocked Prone.

entities.name: Colossus Slayer
entities.description: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 to a creature missing any of its Hit Points.

activities.name: Colossus Slayer
activities.summary: Once per turn, weapon hit vs a creature missing any HP: +1d8.

entities.name: Horde Breaker
entities.description: Once on each of your turns when you attack with a weapon, you can attack another creature within 5 ft of the original target with the same weapon.

activities.name: Horde Breaker
activities.summary: Once per turn: another attack with the same weapon against a creature within 5 ft of the target.

entities.name: Escape the Horde
entities.description: Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.

entities.name: Multiattack Defense
entities.description: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, it has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

entities.name: Protector
entities.description: Proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Heavy armor.

entities.name: Thaumaturge
entities.description: One extra Cleric cantrip; add your Wisdom modifier (min +1) to Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks.

entities.name: Divine Strike
entities.description: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant (2d8 from level 14).

activities.name: Divine Strike
activities.summary: Once per turn, weapon hit: Necrotic or Radiant.

entities.name: Potent Spellcasting
entities.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of Cleric cantrips. Level 14: a damaging cantrip also gives Temp HP equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.

entities.name: Magician
entities.description: One extra Druid cantrip; add your Wisdom modifier (min +1) to Intelligence (Arcana or Nature) checks.

entities.name: Warden
entities.description: Proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor.

entities.name: Potent Spellcasting
entities.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of Druid cantrips. Level 15: Druid cantrips with a range of 10+ ft reach 300 ft farther.

entities.name: Primal Strike
entities.description: Once per turn, a weapon or Beast-form attack hit deals an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder (2d8 from level 15).

activities.name: Primal Strike
activities.summary: Once per turn on a weapon or Beast-form hit: Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder.

entities.name: Arid Land
entities.description: Circle spells of the arid land; Nature's Ward (level 10) gives Resistance to Fire.

entities.name: Polar Land
entities.description: Circle spells of the polar land; Nature's Ward (level 10) gives Resistance to Cold.

entities.name: Temperate Land
entities.description: Circle spells of the temperate land; Nature's Ward (level 10) gives Resistance to Lightning.

entities.name: Tropical Land
entities.description: Circle spells of the tropical land; Nature's Ward (level 10) gives Resistance to Poison.

entities.name: Careful Spell
entities.description: Cost: 1 Sorcery Point. Up to Cha-mod creatures (min 1) succeed on the save and take no damage on half-damage saves.

activities.name: Careful Spell
activities.summary: Up to Cha-mod creatures (min 1) succeed on the save and take no damage on half-damage saves.

entities.name: Distant Spell
entities.description: Cost: 1 Sorcery Point. Double a range of 5+ ft, or Touch becomes 30 ft.

activities.name: Distant Spell
activities.summary: Double a range of 5+ ft, or Touch becomes 30 ft.

entities.name: Empowered Spell
entities.description: Cost: 1 Sorcery Point. Reroll up to Cha-mod damage dice (min 1); combines with other options.

activities.name: Empowered Spell
activities.summary: Reroll up to Cha-mod damage dice (min 1); combines with other options.

entities.name: Extended Spell
entities.description: Cost: 1 Sorcery Point. Double a duration of 1 minute+ (max 24 h); Advantage on Concentration saves for it.

activities.name: Extended Spell
activities.summary: Double a duration of 1 minute+ (max 24 h); Advantage on Concentration saves for it.

entities.name: Heightened Spell
entities.description: Cost: 2 Sorcery Points. One target has Disadvantage on saves against the spell.

activities.name: Heightened Spell
activities.summary: One target has Disadvantage on saves against the spell.

entities.name: Quickened Spell
entities.description: Cost: 2 Sorcery Points. Action casting time becomes a Bonus Action (no other level 1+ spell this turn).

activities.name: Quickened Spell
activities.summary: Action casting time becomes a Bonus Action (no other level 1+ spell this turn).

entities.name: Seeking Spell
entities.description: Cost: 1 Sorcery Point. Reroll a missed spell attack roll; combines with other options.

activities.name: Seeking Spell
activities.summary: Reroll a missed spell attack roll; combines with other options.

entities.name: Subtle Spell
entities.description: Cost: 1 Sorcery Point. Cast without Verbal, Somatic or non-costly Material components.

activities.name: Subtle Spell
activities.summary: Cast without Verbal, Somatic or non-costly Material components.

entities.name: Transmuted Spell
entities.description: Cost: 1 Sorcery Point. Change Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison or Thunder damage to another of them.

activities.name: Transmuted Spell
activities.summary: Change Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison or Thunder damage to another of them.

entities.name: Twinned Spell
entities.description: Cost: 1 Sorcery Point. Raise the spell’s effective level by 1 to target one more creature.

activities.name: Twinned Spell
